profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, traded under the ticker CDNS and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000813672. On its own website, the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider delivering hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. It also describes itself as a great company, citing its culture, a Fortune 100 Great Places to Work listing, and its investment in sustainability.

The harvested site text does not name specific Cadence products, and no products are recorded among the company's held facts. The site material also does not set out any AI-specific offerings, so the company's position on AI cannot be characterized from this data beyond the general Intelligent System Design framing it uses for itself.

The held facts add little beyond the corporate record. No lawsuits involving the company are listed, and no MCP servers are recorded. The only litigation-related figure is a California exposure count of 281.
